table.retrieve:
select 
	icode=code1,
	saleprice=Round(item.saleprice/ CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	purprice=Round(item.purprice/ CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	avgprice=item.avgprice,
	saleqty=isnull(value3,0),
	srqty=isnull(value4,0),
	purqty=isnull(value5,0),
	prqty=isnull(value6,0),
	netadjqty=isnull(value7,0),
	netissue=isnull(value8,0),
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	itemname=item.name,
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	category=(select name from itemCategory where icatcode=:ar_catcode),
	classname=itemclass.name,
	itemopeningstock= A.Qty,
	currqty= ISNULL((select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where  icode = reportdata.code1),0)

from 
	reportdata, item LEFT OUTER JOIN itemclass ON (item.iccode=itemclass.iccode),
	(SELECT T.icode, qty=sum(T.qty)
	FROM 
		(SELECT	pd.icode, qty = sum(isnull(case pl.purcatcode 
									when 1 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									when 2 THEN (pd.packqty + pd.bonusqty) * pd.packunits
									else pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty end, 0))
		FROM purledger pl, purdetail pd
		WHERE 
			pl.posted = 'Y' AND 
			pl.purinvcode = pd.purinvcode AND
			pl.postdate < :ar_StartDate and 
			pd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT pd.icode, qty  = - sum(pd.looseqty + pd.bonusqty + pd.packqty * pd.packunits)
		FROM prledger pl, prdetail pd
		WHERE pl.prinvcode = pd.prinvcode AND
				pl.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			pd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By pd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM saleledger sl, saledetail sd
		WHERE sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode AND
			 sl.date < :ar_StartDate AND sd.Due IS NULL and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty)
		FROM srledger sl, srdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.srinvcode = sd.srinvcode AND
			 sl.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty  = -sum(sd.qty)
		FROM issueheader sl, issuedetail sd
		WHERE sl.issueinvcode = sd.issueinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ar_StartDate  and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty  = sum(sd.qty)
		FROM receiptheader sl, receiptdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.receiptinvcode = sd.receiptinvcode AND
				sl.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		select sd.icode, qty = sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 1 AND
				sl.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT sd.icode, qty = -sum(sd.looseqty)
		FROM Adjheader sl, Adjdetail sd
		WHERE sl.posted = 'Y' AND sl.Adjcode = sd.Adjcode and sl.Adjcatcode = 2 AND
				sl.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			sd.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By sd.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT d.icode, qty = -sum(d.duesatisfyqty)
		FROM duesatisfyheader h, duesatisfydetail d
		WHERE h.duesatisfycode=d.duesatisfycode AND
				h.duesatisfydate < :ar_StartDate and 
			d.icode in (select icode from item where icatcode = :ar_catcode)
		Group By d.icode
		UNION ALL
		SELECT icode,qty=0
		FROM item
	    WHERE Item.icatcode IN (:ar_catcode)) T
	GROUP BY T.Icode) A
where 
	reportdata.code1=item.icode AND 
	item.icode = a.icode
order by 
	itemclass.name, item.name

objects.name: compute_32
objects.expression: sum(( itemopeningstock  +  purqty  +  srqty  -  prqty  -  saleqty  -  netissue  +  netadjqty  ) * saleprice  for all)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: sum( purprice  *  (  saleqty   -   srqty   ) for all)

objects.name: compute_30
objects.expression: sum( saleprice * (  saleqty  -  srqty )  -  (purprice *  (  saleqty    -   srqty   )) for all)

objects.name: compute_11

objects.name: compute_29

objects.name: compute_27
